patches.reason: When a hit or miss is set to step the intensity down, each set starts at powerLevelMax, which is never defined (only powerLevelMin = pLevelMin is), so Groovy failed there. Start at the saved maximum, pLevelMax.

BoxMullerRandom takes Math.log(getRandom(1000)/1000), the log of zero whenever getRandom(1000) gives 0 (one draw in a thousand), which gave -Infinity in Groovy and stops the script in TeaseScript. U is drawn from (getRandom(1000)+1)/1001 instead, which is never zero and keeps the distribution almost the same.
